findings.source: Architect-executed repro; this review read the saved driver/result and confirmed the source path only.
findings.issue: Runtime endpoint liveness checks the chosen original outer point but not survival of the strict common interior witness/path. Parent y0..0.1 can keep a child y0.2..0.8 supported after common embed material is removed.

The independent pass disables all ALL-port groups, so a valid independent first fitting cannot root a parent of a second fitting. All six ports are live, there are no old-edge conflicts, but fit-b and b-upper remain unrooted.
Caller anchor objects remain mutable references. Changing partId/elevation after construction moves the root from the ground part to a disconnected floating part at the same generation and revision.

limits: Partial disabled core consumes caller-supplied fixed original point/primitive/component/native-record/cell identities and authoritative surviving fragment triangles. No full footprint/catalogue/asset binding or live integration established. WIP .txt adapters were not restored or run.
